definitions.explanation: A sale event offering products at reduced prices, typically for a limited time.

examples.japanese: スーパーで{卵|たまご}が{特売|とくばい}になっている。
examples.english: Eggs are on special sale at the supermarket.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}{特売|とくばい}セールを{開催|かいさい}します。
examples.english: We will hold a weekend special sale.

examples.japanese: {特売|とくばい}{品|ひん}は{数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}です。
examples.english: Sale items are limited in quantity.

examples.japanese: チラシを{見|み}て{特売|とくばい}の{野菜|やさい}を{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I looked at the flyer and went to buy the vegetables on special sale.

examples.japanese: {毎週|まいしゅう}{金曜日|きんようび}は{特売|とくばい}{日|び}なので、{店|みせ}の{前|まえ}に{長|なが}い{列|れつ}ができる。
examples.english: Every Friday is a sale day, so a long line forms in front of the store.

notes:
USAGE: {特売|とくばい} refers to limited-time sales at supermarkets, department stores, and other retail outlets.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {特売|とくばい}になっている (to be on sale)
- {特売|とくばい}で{買|か}う (to buy on sale)
- {特売|とくばい}{品|ひん} (sale item)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {特売|とくばい}{日|び} (sale day)
- {特売|とくばい}{品|ひん} (sale item, bargain item)
- {特売|とくばい}セール (special sale event)
- {目玉|めだま}{特売|とくばい} (featured sale item)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- セール - sale (general term, from English)
- {安売|やすう}り - selling cheaply
- {大売出|おおうりだ}し - big sale
